step1_analysis.description: Although the paper describes a 26-42 GHz LNA, the provided netlist is a passive RC network representing a substrate parasitic model (likely for an on-chip inductor, transmission line, or RF pad). It models the oxide capacitance, oxide resistance, and substrate resistance to capture coupling to the lossy substrate.

paper_reference.title: 26–42 GHz SOI CMOS Low Noise Amplifier

Z_mag_35GHz.description: Impedance magnitude of the substrate network at the LNA operating frequency (35 GHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = (Rox || 1/(j*w*Cox)) + Rsi. At 35 GHz, w=2.2e11. Z_Cox = -j454.7 ohm. Z_top = 113.5 - j424.3 ohm. Z_total = 173.5 - j424.3 ohm. Mag = 458.4 ohm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated directly from the provided R and C values at 35 GHz.

Rp_35GHz.description: Equivalent parallel resistance of the substrate network at 35 GHz, representing substrate loss.

Cp_35GHz.description: Equivalent parallel capacitance of the substrate network at 35 GHz.

Q_35GHz.description: Quality factor of the substrate parasitic network at 35 GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the impedance, equivalent parallel resistance, capacitance, and quality factor of the substrate model at 35 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Substrate Parasitic Model Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
Cox N0 N1 10f
Rox N0 N1 1.7k
Rsi N1 GND 60

* Test Source (1A AC current injected into N0)
I1 GND N0 AC 1

.control
ac dec 100 1G 100G

* Calculate metrics over frequency
let omega = 2 * pi * frequency
let Z_mag = mag(v(N0))
let Z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N0))
let Z_real = real(v(N0))
let Z_imag = imag(v(N0))

let Y_real = real(1/v(N0))
let Y_imag = imag(1/v(N0))

let Rp = 1 / Y_real
let Cp = Y_imag / omega
let Q = abs(Z_imag) / Z_real

* Measure at 35 GHz (LNA operating frequency)
meas ac Z_mag_35G find Z_mag at=35G
meas ac Z_phase_35G find Z_phase at=35G
meas ac Rp_35G find Rp at=35G
meas ac Cp_35G find Cp at=35G
meas ac Q_35G find Q at=35G

print Z_mag_35G Z_phase_35G Rp_35G Cp_35G Q_35G
quit
.endc
.end
